collection.title: Mercedes-Benz E Class Estate 2009 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz E Class Estate 2009 to 2014 (W212) model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Side Pin arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this E Class, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
